heading: Delegation of functions

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: An eligible lender or guaranty agency that contracts with another entity to perform any of the lender’s or agency’s functions under this subchapter, or otherwise delegates the performance of such functions to such other entity—

children.text: shall not be relieved of the lender’s or agency’s duty to comply with the requirements of this subchapter; and
shall monitor the activities of such other entity for compliance with such requirements.

tree.heading: Special rule
tree.text: A lender that holds a loan made under this part in the lender’s capacity as a trustee is responsible for complying with all statutory and regulatory requirements imposed on any other holder of a loan made under this part.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1998—Pub. L. 105–244 amended section catchline and text generally. Prior to amendment, section authorized establishment of a District of Columbia student loan insurance program.
